name: CH Packschein
tagline: Cross-docking packschein workflow for HelloFresh CH
description: A Google Apps Script system that powers the HelloFresh Switzerland cross-docking packschein workflow. It covers packing, double-checking, a procurement web app, weekly archiving and exports — turning a manual paper-based process into a structured, trackable operation.
installNotes: Deployed via clasp to a Google Sheet bound project. Clone the repo, run `clasp push`, then open the bound spreadsheet and use the custom menu to run the workflow.

name: Training Signup
tagline: Training signups, calendar sync & waitlists for HF DACH
description: An Apps Script system for HelloFresh DACH training signups. It syncs signups to a calendar, manages a waiting list, sends branded confirmation emails, and exposes a signup web app — all inside the team's own Google Workspace.
installNotes: Deploy as a web app with clasp (`clasp push`, then `clasp deploy`). Configure the sheet-driven settings, install triggers, and share the web app URL with trainees.

name: Calendar Room Audit
tagline: Daily email digest of meetings missing a room
description: Scans your Google Calendar every weekday morning and emails a grouped summary of meetings that need attention: events where the room resource declined, and meetings you organised with people but no room booked. Recurring meetings without a room are intentionally skipped.
features: Flags meetings with no room booked
installNotes: A standalone Apps Script project synced with clasp. Clone, `clasp push`, set the script ID, and install the time-based trigger to run the audit each weekday.

name: CC Single Keyword Campaign Tool
tagline: Amazon SKAG bulk-upload generator
description: Generates Amazon Advertising Sponsored Products bulk-upload files using the SKAG (Single Keyword Ad Group) pattern — one keyword per campaign, ad group and keyword row. Every keyword gets its own daily budget and placement modifiers for precise optimisation.
installNotes: Copy the spreadsheet, fill in the `_Config` tab, then run the custom menu 'Campaign Creator → Create Export' and download the generated .xlsx to upload to Amazon Ads.

name: Amazon Exact Keywords
tagline: Amazon Ads SKAG campaign generator
description: A Google Apps Script tool that builds Amazon Ads SKAG (Single Keyword Ad Group) campaigns from a keyword list, generating structured bulk-upload files ready for Amazon Ads.
installNotes: Copy the Google Sheet, add your keywords, and run the script from the custom menu to generate the Amazon bulk-upload file.

name: Keyword Recherche Tool
tagline: Full Amazon campaign creation from keyword research
description: A Google Sheets-bound tool that automates Amazon Sponsored Products campaign creation. It imports keyword data from Helium 10 / Cerebro exports, cleans and tags keywords, then generates a fully structured Amazon bulk-upload .xlsx covering campaigns, ad groups, product ads, negatives and bid placements. Supports manual, auto and product-targeting campaigns.
installNotes: Internal tool (no public repo). Bound to a Google Sheet — import keyword data, work in the tagged Keywords tab, then generate the bulk-upload export from the custom menu.

name: Theme Colour Editor
tagline: Set & save custom theme colours across your Sheets
description: A Google Sheets add-on for setting and saving custom theme colours across all your spreadsheets — no more typing hex codes every time. Colours are saved to your user profile and carry through to every sheet, including injecting extra colours into the paint-bucket palette.
features: All 9 theme slots in one go
Extra colours in the paint palette
installNotes: Deployed as a Google Sheets add-on via clasp. Open the add-on, set your colours once, and they apply across all your spreadsheets.

name: Databricks → Sheets Writer
tagline: Write Databricks SQL results into Google Sheets
description: An Apps Script web app that receives Databricks SQL query results (chunked via S3 URLs) from an n8n workflow and writes them to the correct sheet tabs. A Config sheet drives which queries run and where results land, with a shared-secret API key protecting the endpoint.
installNotes: Internal tool (no public repo). Deployed as a web app and called by an n8n workflow via HTTP POST with an API key.

name: Action Item Tracker
tagline: Turn Gemini meeting notes into tracked action items
description: Automatically collects action items from your Gemini meeting-notes emails into one Google Sheet and sends a nightly digest (email + optional Slack) of just what's new. Runs entirely inside your own Google account — no server or shared backend.
installNotes: Copy the spreadsheet, follow the Instructions tab, optionally add a Gemini API key and Slack token, then install the nightly trigger or run it manually from the menu.

name: Factor Weight Scales Tool
tagline: Weight scale data processing for Factor & Verden
description: A suite of Apps Script tools supporting the weight scales in Verden for both HelloFresh and Factor. It imports weight files, prepares PDL and picklist data, generates reset/tracking CSVs, and exports results to Excel.
installNotes: Internal operations tool. Deployed via clasp to the weight-scales spreadsheet; run the processing steps from the custom menu in sequence.

name: Weight Scales for HelloFresh
tagline: Weight scale data tools for HelloFresh
description: Apps Script tooling that supports the weight scales used in HelloFresh production, handling the import and processing of weight data.
installNotes: Internal operations tool deployed via clasp to the weight-scales spreadsheet.

name: ALPS Verden Support
tagline: Scripts supporting the Verden assembly line planning
description: Apps Script tooling that supports the assembly line planning system for Verden production, helping plan and track the line.
installNotes: Internal operations tool deployed via clasp to the planning spreadsheet.

name: Ranked Customer CRM
tagline: Customer CRM with billing & keyword research
description: A Google Apps Script CRM for Ranked, managing customers with dialogs for billing, keyword costs, folder structure settings and keyword research. Includes branded welcome emails and a customer list interface.
installNotes: Internal tool (no public repo). Bound to a Google Sheet; use the custom menu to open the CRM dialogs.

name: CH Product Data Alerts
tagline: Weekly Slack & email alerts for CH product data quality
description: Monitors a set of data-quality checks in a Google Sheet and, every Monday morning, dispatches Slack and email notifications for any check with an active issue. A secondary script keeps the menu-visual week dropdown in sync.
installNotes: Internal tool (no public repo). Bound to the 'CH | Product Data [LIVE]' sheet; install the Monday-morning trigger to run `checkAndSendAlerts()`.

name: Weekly Report
tagline: Automated weekly reporting web app
description: A Google Apps Script web app that generates and emails a branded weekly report, with audit and configuration logic plus an HTML email template.
installNotes: Internal tool (no public repo). Deployed as a web app; configure in the Config tab and install the weekly trigger.

name: Slack & Email Alerts
tagline: Reusable Slack + email alert sender
description: A reusable Apps Script module for sending Slack and branded HTML email notifications from Google Sheets, with a clean configuration layer.
installNotes: Internal tool (no public repo). Copy the script into a sheet project, configure the Config tab, and call the send functions from your own triggers.

name: Google Apps Scripts Collection
tagline: A collection of mini scripts & tools
description: A public collection of mini scripts and reusable tools for Google Apps Script, including an introduction wiki and design standards for building clean, consistent sheet-based tools.
installNotes: Browse the repo and wiki, then copy the scripts you need into your own Apps Script project.

name: Open-Meteo Weather Data
tagline: Pull past & future weather data from Open-Meteo
description: A Google Apps Script tool that pulls historical and forecast weather data from the Open-Meteo API into a Google Sheet, useful for analysis and planning.
installNotes: Copy the script into a Google Sheet project and run it to fetch weather data for your chosen location and dates.

name: Update TVS
tagline: Automated sheet updates
description: A Google Apps Script utility for updating data in Google Sheets, part of the author's GAS toolkit.
installNotes: Copy the script into your sheet project and adapt the update logic to your data.

name: Amazon Keyword Research & Campaign Creation
tagline: Automated Amazon keyword research & campaign creation
description: A project for CleverClick & Ranked that automates Amazon keyword research and the creation of campaigns from those keywords.
installNotes: Copy the sheet and run the research + campaign creation scripts from the custom menu.

name: Graph Risk Matrix
tagline: Graph project risks on an interactive chart
description: Graphs a risk matrix (potential impact & probability) in Google Sheets. Each point is placed into the correct quadrant and distributed evenly within it, giving a clean visual of project risks.
installNotes: Copy the script into your sheet, add your risk data, and run the graphing function to render the matrix.

name: Sensitivity Analysis Add-on
tagline: Run sensitivity analysis on your Sheets model
description: A Google Sheets add-on that lets you quickly run a sensitivity analysis by manipulating two variables and recording the effect on a model. Simple to install and adapt to your own needs.
installNotes: Copy the script into your sheet, run 'Sensitivity analysis' from the menu, grant permission, and follow the pop-ups.

name: Amazon Keyword Analyser
tagline: Analyse & clean Amazon keywords
description: A project for CleverClick & Ranked that analyses Amazon keywords and cleans them, preparing data for campaign use.
installNotes: Copy the sheet, import your keyword data, and run the analysis/cleaning scripts from the custom menu.

name: Placetel Record Evaluation
tagline: Evaluate Placetel call metrics in Google Sheets
description: Scripts used in Google Sheets to evaluate call metrics from the Placetel provider, turning call records into usable reporting data.
installNotes: Copy the script into a Google Sheet with your Placetel call data and run the evaluation functions.

name: Recipe Card Generator
tagline: Print-ready recipe cards from tabular data
description: Generates HelloFresh recipe cards as print-ready PDFs from tabular data, with an Apps Script component. Each recipe produces a two-page A4 landscape PDF that matches the source card layout.
installNotes: Internal tool (no public repo). Primarily a Python renderer using headless Chrome; the Apps Script component handles sheet-side data prep.
